summary: Independent review of the revised frozen specification at subject5c9a7ff and contextfada4095. Retain the accepted one-line canonical event append repair; add only the explicit --no-optional-locks global argv option in the two read-only Git collectors. The actual required Linux CI log records eight rejection snapshot failures differing in index stat/identity; two Windows forced-stale-index regressions independently expose optional index writes under inherited GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=1. The design keeps observed Git facts, timeouts, errors, full index bytes/identity/timestamps and lock-file assertions intact, changes no caller environment or Git configuration, and retains full native V2,85/90,five mutations and actual exact-head required Linux CI before merge. No findings. This design review does not assert a successful new implementation, authorize an execution action, or grant publication/target authority.
